components.name: AreaChart
limitations: Hover tooltips are pointer-only; the data table exposes the same values to keyboard and assistive-technology users.
Legend visibility is local presentation state, not a second DSL state store.
Arbitrary colors, JavaScript callbacks, remote data, detached legend stores and export APIs are not exposed by this DSL.
components.docs: Renders the MIT OpenUI React/D3 implementation pinned at cf615ae1401d78eee1a4dcc1ef0e2e6d61f373d7. Supplied data only; no services, callbacks, downloads or telemetry. Empty input produces an explicit empty state; all-zero input remains zero. A keyboard-operable data table provides every original value. Theme colors inherit Inform tokens, including portaled tooltips. Animation defaults off and respects reduced motion. Null values are rejected; signed values retain the upstream zero baseline.

Empty input produces an explicit empty state; all-zero input remains zero. A keyboard-operable data table provides every original value. Theme colors inherit Inform tokens, including portaled tooltips. Animation defaults off and respects reduced motion. Stage order is supplied order. Percentages are relative to the first stage, not the sum. Non-negative values; no forced monotonic reordering. When the first stage is zero but later stages are positive, set showPercentage:false because retention is undefined.

dataShapes.name: Series
dataShapes.description: Named finite series; null is supported only by HeatmapChart as a missing cell.

dataShapes.name: Slice
dataShapes.description: Named non-negative magnitude for pie, radial, funnel or segmented charts.

dataShapes.name: Point
dataShapes.description: A finite scatter coordinate. Negative and zero values are supported.

dataShapes.name: ScatterSeries
dataShapes.description: Named scatter dataset containing finite Point values.

dataShapes.name: CalendarDay
dataShapes.description: ISO calendar day and non-negative magnitude. Duplicate dates are summed by the upstream calendar.
